identity.name: Edifice Chronograph
identity.one_liner: The 2006 Edifice chronograph with the 4344 quartz caliber — the affordable Casio chronograph that defined "a steel sport chronograph under $300".

narrative.story: The EF-527D was introduced in 2006 as the entry Edifice chronograph. The 4344 quartz caliber is a standard Casio analog-digital chronograph with a 1/100th second stopwatch, a daily alarm, a 100m water resistance, and a 3-year battery. The 43mm stainless steel case, the tachymeter bezel, and the mineral crystal are the 2006 specification. The Edifice is the most-cited affordable Casio chronograph and the watch a collector buys as their "first chronograph" before they know anything about watches.
narrative.collector_notes: The Edifice line was launched in 2000 to compete with the Tissot PRC 200 at the entry chronograph price point. The line now includes over 200 references.
